messages.author: 299a5089d6c6c523
messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] How to disable user ID and Password in shiny web application??
parts:
We do not set the R locale until after we have built the images, and the package KoNLP has an issue where it fails to handle that situation:

 if(all((localeToCharset()[1] == c("UTF-8", "CP949", "EUC-KR")) == FALSE)){ packageStartupMessage("This R shell doesn't contain any Hangul encoding.\nFor fully use, any of 'UTF-8', 'CP949', 'EUC-KR' needs to be used for R shell encoding.") }

Error : .onAttach failed in attachNamespace() for 'KoNLP', details:
  call: if (all((localeToCharset()[1] == c("UTF-8", "CP949", "EUC-KR")) ==
  error: missing value where TRUE/FALSE needed
Error: loading failed
Execution halted
ERROR: loading failed
* removing ‘/usr/local/lib/R/site-library/KoNLP’

The downloaded source packages are in
‘/tmp/RtmpKOvEqg/downloaded_packages’
Warning message:
In install.packages("KoNLP") :
  installation of package ‘KoNLP’ had non-zero exit status
> localeToCharset()
[1] NA

I would recommend following up with the package maintainer.
On Monday, May 9, 2016 at 7:34:38 AM UTC-5, Tareef Kawaf wrote:
Is this the complete error that was returned?  I am guessing that the KoNLP package may have a dependency on some library that isn't installed on shinyapps.io.
